stories.title: 420-metre Poisar River stretch to get protective wall in ₹9 crore flood-control project
stories.summary: 08 crore to address recurring flooding in Hanuman Nagar, a low-lying locality that has witnessed flood-like situations during heavy rainfall over the past few years. Overflowing river water often inundates adjoining lanes and homes, disrupting daily life and making it difficult for residents to move around during the monsoon.

stories.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Mumbai crime branch issues Look Out Circular against Abhishek Pandit
stories.summary: Mumbai Police on Friday issued a Look Out Circular (LOC) against gangster Anil Pandit's brother, Abhishek Pandit. Anil Pandit is an alleged mastermind behind the October 18 firing at actor Tiger Shroff, while according to the police, Abhishek managed the gang’s finances and funded the arrested suspects through bank accounts opened in his own name.

stories.title: Fire station at Andheri may finally take shape
stories.summary: On Friday, BJP corporator Rupesh Sawarkar met BMC commissioner Ashwini Bhide, seeking completion of the land transfer and construction tender process within 90 days. Sawarkar said the area urgently needed a fire station. The demand follows the Nov 7 fire at Runwal Elegante, Lokhandwala, in which 46-year-old lift operator Dhanpat Mahatu died of smoke inhalation.

stories.title: Mumbai: Born At 24 Weeks Weighing 540 Grams, Baby Survives Multiple Complications After 4 Months In NICU
stories.summary: Born at just 24 weeks and one day of pregnancy, the baby boy was at the peri-viable stage, when survival is possible but remains extremely challenging because of the underdevelopment of vital organs. 814 kg at the time of discharge. At his six-month follow-up, he is reportedly doing well, smiling and playing.

stories.title: Delivery worker lies hurt for 20 mins after crash, dies
stories.summary: A 32-year-old delivery worker died after he fell off his motorcycle and came under the rear wheel of a truck in Ulhasnagar on Thursday afternoon. He lay critically injured on the road for over 20 minutes before passers-by took him to hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

stories.title: IIT-Bombay alumnus, 2014-batch IRTS officer Arun Kumar Meena takes charge as Western Railway CPRO
stories.summary: During his career with the Railways, he has held several operational and commercial positions, including Sr DOM (general) at Ahmedabad Division, divisional commercial manager (FM), divisional operations manager and assistant operations manager (M) at Mumbai Central Division. Meena has received the General Manager’s Award in recognition of his service.

stories.title: BKC pedestrian bridge proposal linking Sion and Chunabhatti remains stalled
stories.summary: While thousands of Mumbaikars commute to Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) , navigating shared autos and congested roads, a citizen-led push for pedestrian-only bridges connecting the business district to Sion and Chunabhatti remains stalled, with its proponents now making their proposal public. Members of the Walking Project (WP) took to social media on Friday, saying that a year ago, citizens had launched an online campaign seeking pedestrian bridges connecting BKC with the Kurla-Sion region.

stories.title: Mumbai crime: 30-year-old found dead in bushes along Mahape-Shilphata Road
stories.summary: A routine trip from home ended in tragedy for a 30-year-old man whose blood-soaked body was found dumped in bushes along the Mahape-Shilphata Road on Wednesday evening. Identified as Manu Madan Prasad, the victim had sustained fatal injuries to his neck, allegedly inflicted with a sharp-edged weapon. The discovery of his body in an isolated stretch of the road has left Turbhe police investigating a murder with several unanswered questions.

stories.title: 2 killed, 47 injured as wedding guests’ bus collides with tanker on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway
stories.summary: At least two passengers were killed and several others were injured after a luxury bus carrying 49 wedding guests collided with a tanker on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway near Gujarat’s Derol early on Friday, officials said. 30 am when the bus, travelling from Dhoraji to Surat for a wedding, rammed into the tanker, police officers said.

stories.summary: In connection with the case, the Colaba Police on Friday (November 20) arrested a 21-year-old apprentice working at the Naval Dockyard. The accused has been identified as Bunty Ramprakash Meena, a resident of Karauli district in Rajasthan. He is accused of uploading photographs and videos of the Naval Dockyard and other sensitive Indian Navy installations on social media.

stories.title: Mumbai: MACT Awards ₹79.50 Lakh To Family Of Income Tax Employee Killed In BEST Bus Accident
stories.summary: In its November 19 order, Member A. A. Ghaniwale held that the driver's conduct amounted to negligence under the Motor Vehicles Act, even though the charge sheet did not indicate criminal negligence on his part. The tribunal emphasised that negligence under the Act encompasses both civil and criminal negligence.

stories.title: Mumbai Infra Update: BMC Prepares To Launch Girders For Bandra-Dharavi Bridge, 10-Lane Project Enters Crucial Phase
stories.summary: Being executed at a cost of Rs 204 crore, the project forms part of the larger Mithi River widening initiative. The new bridge will connect the Jio World Drive road junction near BKC, along the Western Express Highway, to Dharavi, ending nearly 110 metres south of the Mithi River.

stories.title: DBS Bank India brings its DBS Treasures Wealth experience to Borivali, Mumbai
stories.summary: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 20: DBS Bank India today announced that its Borivali branch in Mumbai is now a dedicated DBS Treasures Wealth Branch, deepening the bank’s wealth management proposition in one of India’s most dynamic markets. Designed for affluent, high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth customers, the branch combines DBS’ wealth management capabilities, regional expertise and cross-border connectivity to deliver a differentiated banking experience.

stories.title: Prabhadevi railway land demolition halted after intervention by Fadnavis
stories.summary: For those residing on railway land near Prabhadevi station , Friday began with fear and anxiety, with Western Railway (WR) authorities arriving at their doorstep in the morning with police personnel and excavators with an aim to demolish 101 houses.

stories.summary: 30 metres. Following the action, an approximately 30-metre-long stretch has been cleared to the proposed width, removing a major traffic bottleneck near Girish Keni Chawl. The move is expected to improve vehicular movement and ease congestion in the area. The BMC has also directed the Roads Department to expedite construction of a cement concrete (CC) road on the cleared stretch so that it can be opened for traffic at the earliest.

stories.title: Mumbai local train updates: Central Railway announces Sunday mega block
stories.summary: Commuters travelling by local trains on Sunday will face disruptions as Central Railway's Mumbai Division will operate a mega block on its suburban sections to carry out engineering and maintenance work. The block will affect the Main Line and Harbour Line, with changes to suburban train services between Thane and Kalyan and on routes connecting Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) with Chunabhatti and Bandra.

stories.title: BEST projects Rs 8,559 crore revenue in 2027-28, transport deficit to narrow
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) Undertaking has projected a significant rise in revenue and a reduction in its transport division’s deficit in the financial year 2027-28, according to budget estimates presented before the BEST Committee on Friday. 06 crore in 2027-28.

stories.title: Mumbai BMC proposes parking fee hike of up to 50 per cent for two-wheelers
stories.summary: Municipal parking rates across Mumbai could increase by at least 10 per cent with the proposal presently approved by Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) chief Ashwini Bhide. Officials say the hike has been long pending. The proposed hike varies from 10 per cent to up to 50 per cent due to a condition — officials said revised rates after the hike calculations will be rounded to the higher 5.

stories.title: BMC Says Versovas Nana Nani Park Sits On DP Road, Set To Resume Tree Felling Amid Strong Opposition From
stories.summary: Mumbai: The Nana Nani Park in Versova, which has been in the headlines for last few days because of the tree felling undertaken by the BMC to make way for Coastal Road North (Versova Bhayandar Link Road) project and protests by citizens against it, is actually sitting in between a development plan (DP) road…

stories.title: Kiara Advani serves maternity fashion goals in stunning ₹1.43 lakh pink silk dress during Mumbai outing with Sidharth Malhotra
stories.summary: Kiara turned heads in a vibrant pink maxi dress that perfectly blended modern elegance with femininity. Crafted from lustrous crinkled silk, the dress featured a fluid silhouette that draped beautifully, making it both comfortable and chic. The design stood out with its delicate twisted straps and an integrated front tie that added definition to the waist, creating soft, sculptural ruching.

stories.title: Mumbai: Panvel-Karjat line moves closer to launch as power supply begins December 15
stories.summary: The long-awaited Panvel-Karjat suburban railway line is inching closer to completion. stories.title: Within six weeks of launch, Pune’s direct e-bus link to Navi Mumbai airport faces uncertainty | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Just six weeks after the Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) launched direct electric bus services connecting Pune to the Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA), the service is facing uncertainty, with online bookings suspended and passengers reporting abrupt cancellations. A Pune passenger was left stranded on November 19 after his scheduled MSRTC bus to NMIA was cancelled without prior intimation.

stories.title: Maharashtra government rolls out 80% recruitment quota for women nurses, male nurses oppose
stories.summary: Male nurses are accusing the state of gender bias over its decision to reserve 80% of nursing posts in recruitments for government hospitals for women nurses. This policy decision was announced by the state department for medical education in June last year but is being implemented for the first time now following an announcement by the MPSC on November 6.

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan receives death threat in the name of Baba Siddique's alleged killers; police launch investigation
stories.summary: Actor Saif Ali Khan has become the latest high-profile individual from Hindi cinema to receive a death threat, the Mumbai Police confirmed on Thursday. The actor allegedly received a threat in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, a wanted accused in the murder of politician Baba Siddique . Police have launched an investigation.

stories.summary: 40-metre-wide Development Plan (DP) road in K-East ward. The road runs between Hasanath School on Kadamwadi Road and Uttam Dhaba on Marol-Maroshi Road. Officials said the structures were pulled down after the necessary legal formalities were completed, and the remaining 64 will be cleared over the next two days.

stories.title: Mumbai: GRP, RPF step up patrolling under Bandra East foot overbridge
stories.summary: A day after mid-day reported a suspected sale of unidentified tablets beneath the Bandra East foot overbridge, the Government Railway Police (GRP) and Railway Protection Force (RPF) have stepped up patrolling in the area to prevent any unlawful activities, with officers keeping a close watch on the area.

stories.summary: The long-awaited Panvel-Karjat suburban railway line is inching closer to completion. stories.title: Mumbai: Yeoor leopard’s recovery gets a boost from native honeybee honey at SGNP
stories.summary: When a severely injured male leopard was rescued from Mama Bhanja Hills in the Yeoor Range of Sanjay Gandhi National Park (SGNP) on May 31, 2026, his chances of recovery appeared slim. Extremely weak, emaciated and suffering from multiple infected wounds, the animal was fighting for survival.

stories.title: Sonu Nigam Turns Raipur-Mumbai Flight Into Concert, Sings His Hit Songs For Passengers Mid-Air - VIDEO
stories.summary: Stalwart singer Sonu Nigam was in for a heartwarming surprise when passengers on a flight broke into an impromptu musical performance. They were seen singing some of his most loved songs for him and turning the aircraft into a mini concert venue.

stories.title: Thane: Labourer dies after iron-laden handcart overturns on him
stories.summary: A 50-year-old worker died after a handcart loaded with iron angles overturned on him at an industrial unit in Dombivli MIDC Phase-1 in Maharashtra's Thane district , police said on Friday. The deceased, identified as Hameed Mohammad Shaikh, was a mathadi worker (head-loader) and had been working at the steel company for the past 30 years, police said.

Its epicentre was in the Andes, 34 kilometres (21 miles) north of Junin, at a depth of 108 kilometres (67 miles).

stories.title: Shiv Nadar tops philanthropy list for fifth year; India's richest donate Rs 11,554 crore
stories.summary: The report, now in its 13th edition, shows that 219 philanthropists collectively donated Rs 11,554 crore during the financial year, an increase of 11% over the Rs 10,380 crore recorded last year. Gautam Adani and his family climbed three places to the second position after more than doubling their contribution to Rs 877 crore, an increase of 127%.

stories.title: Cyberattack hits vendors linked to JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard; customer data potentially exposed
stories.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard disclosed on Thursday that third-party vendors were hit in a cyberattack, potentially exposing limited marketing data such as customer names and email addresses. All three firms emphasised that their core networks and payment card details remained uncompromised, and JPMorgan noted that the incident was unrelated to its earlier-week software outage.

stories.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
stories.summary: New York City's official overseeing the closure of the city's most notorious jail hopes a new plan from Mayor Zohran Mamdani will lead to "a moment of transformation" for how people are detained in the largest US city. Mamdani on Friday unveiled a plan to close the Rikers Island complex by 2032, to build four new jails and drastically reduce the city's detainee population.

stories.title: Canada names Goldy Brar in most-wanted fugitive list for murder, announces reward
stories.summary: Gangster Satinderjeet Singh alias Goldy Brar has been named Canada's most-wanted fugitive under a public safety initiative, which has also announced a reward of 250,000 Canadian dollars, for information leading to his arrest, people aware of the matter said on Friday.

stories.title: Bengal CEO postpones special revision of voter rolls over ‘unavoidable circumstances’
stories.summary: The West Bengal chief electoral officer's (CEO) office has postponed the Special Summary Revision (SSR) of the Photo Electoral Roll, 2027, citing “unavoidable circumstances.” The exercise was scheduled to begin on November 23.

stories.title: Gujarat bans display of caste-related words, symbols on private vehicles
stories.summary: The Gujarat government on Friday announced a ban on displaying caste-identifying words, symbols, signs or text on private vehicles, including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, cars, buses and trucks, by amending the Gujarat Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989. The Gujarat ports and transport department notified the Gujarat Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Rules, 2026, on November 17, introducing provisions that prohibit caste-based displays on vehicles.

stories.title: PM Modi In Bengal, Bihar, UP Today To Unveil Projects Worth Rs 34,000 Crore
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate and dedicate development projects worth around ₹ 34,470 crore and lay the foundation stones for several others during his visit to Bihar’s Vaishali district on Saturday, giving a major push to infrastructure development across the state. The projects span road connectivity, energy, urban infrastructure, water resources, education, healthcare and transport, according to a press release issued by the Press Information Bureau (PIB).

stories.title: Salman Khan says ‘don't judge a book by its cover’ over criticism for Maatrubhumi trailer; shuts down ‘AI-VFX specialists’
stories.summary: Actors Salman Khan and Chitrangada Singh visited Hyderabad on Friday to promote their upcoming film Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace with Apoorva Lakhia. While there, Salman addressed criticism of the film’s recently released trailer. He also spoke about the speculation surrounding AI use in the film, shutting down these ‘specialists’ for not focusing on the story of a soldier.

stories.title: Cauvery dispute: SC dismisses Tamil Nadu's pleas for additional water release from Karnataka
stories.summary: New Delhi, The Supreme Court on Friday dismissed two pleas of the Tamil Nadu government seeking a direction to Karnataka for the release of 11 thousand million cubic feet of Cauvery river water. A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh said that Tamil Nadu has filed a third application for bringing on record some additional documents, which will also be dismissed.

stories.title: ED summons Punjab Chief Secretary, Finance Secretary for questioning
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) on Friday widened its investigation into alleged irregularities in land dealings involving the Punjab government and its development authorities, summoning chief secretary KAP Sinha and principal secretary (finance) Alok Shekhar to appear at its Delhi office on November 26.

stories.title: Ahmedabad: Two arrested for trying to pass off fake Rs 500 notes in Rs 10 lakh deal
stories.summary: Two men were arrested by Gujarat's Ahmedabad Police for allegedly attempting to cheat a person in a Rs 10 lakh transaction by handing over bundles of paper notes resembling genuine Rs 500 currency notes, with fake ICICI Bank labels affixed to them, officials said on Friday. The arrests followed a decoy operation after a complainant approached Ghatlodia Police Station with information about the proposed transaction from Nagpur to Ahmedabad.

stories.title: GTA 6 PC scam alert: $200 malware kit targets gamers with fake downloads and crypto theft
stories.summary: GTA 6 fans waiting for a PC release have become targets of a dangerous online scam. Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered a $200 malware package that uses fake game downloads to trick players into infecting their computers. The toolkit reportedly combines account-stealing software, cryptocurrency theft tools and hidden mining programmes.

stories.title: Fanie de Villiers calls Usman Khawaja 'biggest traitor' for reviving 2018 ball-tampering scandal
stories.summary: Former South Africa fast bowler Fanie de Villiers has called ex-Australia opener Usman Khawaja as the ‘biggest traitor’ he has seen in the game, citing him reviving the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Khawaja’s memoir, Sabr, has claimed the ‘whole team’ knew of the plot to alter the ball in Cape Town Africa eight years ago.

The arrests were made by the Intelligence Fusion and Strategic Operations (IFSO) unit within 15 days of launching the investigation, which exposed an organised network allegedly involved in procuring and supplying bank accounts of bogus firms to receive and divert money obtained through cyber fraud.

stories.summary: "Should the law continue to retain statutory and customary exceptions that permit marriages between close blood relatives, notwithstanding established medical evidence that such unions significantly increase risk of autosomal recessive disorders, congenital anomalies, disabilities, infant morbidity and other lifelong health issues in children?" stories.title: Haryana: Couple, 22-year-old son killed as car rams into parked truck | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A couple and their 22-year-old son from Madhya Pradesh’s Ratlam district were killed after their car rammed into a stationary truck on the Jammu-Katra Expressway near Ghilod village in Rohtak district on Friday morning. According to the police, the deceased have been identified as Karamjit Singh, 48, who was driving the car, his wife Pawandeep Kaur and their son Amarendra Singh, 22.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath’s mother Savitri Devi dies at 91; PM Modi condoles demise
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath’s mother, Savitri Devi (91), died on Friday morning at Panchur, her ancestral village in Uttarakhand’s Pauri Garhwal district. Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to Yogi Adityanath and expressed his condolences over her demise. Union Home Minister Amit Shah also expressed grief over the demise of Yogi Adityanath's mother.

stories.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
stories.summary: A jury in Los Angeles has found a 30-year-old man guilty of starting one of the most destructive wildfires in California's history. Jonathan Rinderknecht was convicted of arson after starting the fires that swept through Pacific Palisades and parts of Malibu in January last year, killing 12 people and destroying more than 6,800 buildings in the US state.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan: Heavy rain inundates low-lying areas of Ichchapuram, Sompeta in Srikakulam district
stories.summary: Srikakulam district has been witnessing heavy rain for the last day under the impact of Cyclone Akvan, which is yet to cross the coast between Ichchapuram in Andhra Pradesh and Gopalpur in Odisha. The heavy rain inundated many low-lying areas of Ichchapuram, Kaviti, Sompeta and other places close to the sea coast of Srikakulam.

stories.title: Two arrested for killing protected Indian rock python in Chandrapur
stories.summary: Two men have been arrested for allegedly killing an Indian rock python, a Schedule I protected species, and illegally handling its carcass in the Babupeth area of Chandrapur. The accused have been identified as Suresh Chelu Rathod (33) and Sandeep Maruti Waghmare (30). Under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, killing or illegally handling protected wildlife attracts imprisonment ranging from three to seven years, along with a fine.

stories.title: From acid attacks to pellet wounds: Delhi-NCR dogs fight back for a second chance at life
stories.summary: At a residence in south Delhi, a golden-furred dog keeps the household on its toes. With his bright coat and features resembling a Golden Retriever, Veer is now almost indistinguishable from any other happy, playful dog. But beneath his cheerful demeanour lies a painful past. An acid attack had left his face so severely damaged that veterinarians initially recommended euthanasia.

stories.title: Katy poses with Justin as past marriage to Russell Brand hits headlines
stories.summary: Katy Perry has been seen accompanying Justin Trudeau on his European visit to several cities. Recent court documents have brought attention back to Perry's past marriage with Russell Brand. Brand's deposition revealed questions about their marriage during alleged incidents of sexual assault involving another woman. Perry and Brand's marriage lasted from 2010 to 2012, concluding with a divorce.

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh Groundwater Alert: Nitrate, Fluoride And Uranium Exceed Safe Limits In Multiple Districts
stories.summary: Lucknow, November 20, 2026: Uttar Pradesh is facing growing concerns over groundwater quality, with official monitoring data indicating the presence of nitrate, fluoride and uranium beyond permissible drinking-water limits in several districts. The findings highlight potential health risks for people who rely on groundwater for drinking and household consumption.

stories.title: 'A Glimmer Of Hope': Rohingya Refugees In Bangladesh Hope For Safe Return To Myanmar After ICJ Genocide Verdict
stories.summary: / @UN_PGA Cox's Bazar: Hundreds of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh sat in front of a big screen at their sprawling camp in Cox's Bazar, watching the news from the Netherlands, where the UN's top court ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in a brutal 2017 military operation.

stories.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
stories.summary: A federal judge sentenced an Indian man to 235 months, more than 19 years, in an attempted plot to kill a leading Sikh political figure in the US. Nikhil Gupta, an Indian national, pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.

stories.title: India, France Condemn Pahalgam Attack And Red Fort Terror Attacks, Pledge Stronger Cooperation Against Cross-Border Terrorism
stories.summary: / @MEAIndia New Delhi: India and France have strongly condemned terrorism in all its forms and manifestations, including cross-border terrorism and violent extremism, while reaffirming their commitment to strengthening cooperation against terror financing, online radicalisation and emerging technological threats at the 18th meeting of the India-France Joint Working Group on Counter Terrorism held in New Delhi.

stories.title: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
stories.summary: Ballistic missiles hit key crossings in the capital during a nationwide assault which Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said was "one of the most massive strikes" of the war so far and left at least nine dead. Russian President Vladimir Putin had threatened to retaliate for the attack on the Crimean Bridge, which the Kremlin built to link Russia and the occupied peninsula.

stories.summary: New Delhi: The US Navy's supply ship USNS Wally Schirra arrived at Larsen & Toubro's (L&T) Kattupalli shipyard near Chennai on November 20 for repairs under the India-US Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA), marking the fifth occasion on which a US naval vessel has undertaken repairs at the facility and highlighting India's growing ship-repair…

stories.title: PM Modi says cultural connect can guarantee global peace
stories.summary: Cultural connect is the biggest guarantee of global peace, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on Friday. Mr. Modi was speaking at the first civilisational dialogue forum of the 10 nation Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) grouping. He said and it was important that at a time when war and unrest were dominating the world, India was holding a dialogue on shared civilisations.

stories.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah to meet India PM Modi on first trip abroad
stories.summary: It is Shah's first bilateral visit since his Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) swept to power in March, six months after a Gen Z uprising against corruption and nepotism toppled K P Sharma Oli's government. The 36-year-old rapper-turned-politician arrives in Delhi on Sunday for a two-day visit, during which he will meet his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi and other senior officials.

stories.title: Russian missiles, drone crash in Poland: Warsaw flags 'provocation' as Ukraine faces aerial barrage
stories.summary: Two Russian cruise missiles and a suspected jet-powered drone crashed in south-eastern Poland on Friday during a massive Russian aerial assault on Ukraine. Polish prime minister Donald Tusk said the incidents appeared to be deliberate, noting that they coincided with major European military exercises in the country. One of the Russian missiles is believed to have crashed around 35 kilometres from the area where the military exercises were under way.

stories.title: In secret memo, Hegseth restricts U.S.-Canada defense relationship
stories.summary: US Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth, has reportedly issued a classified Pentagon memo that restricts the existing defence partnership between US and Canada. The Washington Post reported Friday that the memo was issued last week and has added to the mounting tensions between the two neighbours amid Trump's repeated rhetoric of annexing Canada as America's "51st state".

stories.title: Vance, Rubio Present, Trump Asks Chief Of Staff Stephen Miller, 'Wanna Run For President?'
stories.summary: President Donald Trump took jabs at Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio to their faces as he floated White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller for president. At a White House news conference after returning from Asia, Trump suggested Miller was outperforming both men, who are seen as potential Republican contenders for 2028.
